item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Medication. It's a routine that only works when it's boring and automatic. Your day already has anchors: a morning meditation, a midday check-in, an evening wind-down. Tie your medication to one of those, so you never rely on memory or mood. If you're unsure about timing, doses, or changes, that's a question for your prescriber, not a guess. Action: pick one anchor and take your medication right then.
